concerns.text: The Local Non‑Additivity Index (LNAI) is defined as a point‑biserial correlation between the residual difference (RF_error − Baseline_error) and the binary presence of a fingerprint bit‑pair. Point‑biserial (Pearson) correlation assumes linearity and approximate normality of the continuous variable, which may not hold for residual differences that can be skewed or heavy‑tailed. Consider using a non‑parametric association measure (e.g., rank‑biserial correlation) or a permutation‑based significance test to ensure robustness of the LNAI significance assessment.
